nom: ANUA PDRN 100 Hyaluronic Acid Booster Toner

avis.texte: Absolutely love this stuff! I bought an entirely brand new skincare line all from ANUA about three weeks back and I started noticing a difference within the first THREE days!! My family, friends, and boyfriend all started noticing too! I use the toner as the third step in my routine right after the gel cleanser. I use a cotton pad to apply and it feels light and airy. It kind of feels like your skin is getting dry, however I believe it’s doing the exact opposite! After applying the toner I go in with my PDRN Facial Serum by ANUA and then their lotion. My face has NEVER EVER felt this hydrated, light, and glowy in my entire life! P.S. I originally found out about ANUA from my boyfriend’s mom! She is a licensed Esthetician, among other things, and has owned her own salon/spa business for the past 13+ years. She has done all the research and swears by their PDRN facial serum! P.S.S. I’m not one that EVER likes wearing makeup. Have never bought anything on my own free will, and it has never interested me! The photo is the only one I have of myself recently that shows my skin after one weeks of starting this routine. No filter, no makeup! These two pics are my skincare lineup from left to right, and my skin so far since using this lineup 🙌!
Fabulous toner!! Leaves skin soft, with a glow. I like using a toner with PDRN. This brand has always worked well on my skin. Highly recommend this product!

I use this if I've been out on the beach or after my skin has been through a rough day. It makes it feel moisturized just by itself. The cream that is advertised with it is also very good. The toner helps my skin use the next product better.
This hyaluronic acid toner makes my face plump and it keeps my face hydrated.
I have been using this for a couple months and love how it makes my skin feel ! Definitely recommend

I’ve never been one to get facials or do a whole skin ritual. However I’m 52 and I decided it was time to start ( better late than never 🤣) my esthetician gave me a whole skin ritual for me to follow, she recommended this brand. I’ve been using it for about a month now. Def recommend it to others. My skin is normal to dry.

I’m new at using it, and it’s only been about a month. I do love it though. It has made a difference for me. I combine it with the serum. I spray the serum a few minutes after applying the toner. I do my neck and chest too. I feel like my skin is smoother. Nice glow.
3rd purchase of this toner! Great for sensitive skin, doesn’t leave residue but delivers on moisture. I switched to this from Elemis Collagen toner!

10/10 Definitely recommend this entire line!!! Since using the ANUA skincare line, my skin has never looked or felt better!!! My deep smile lines are disappearing, the skin is hydrated, plump, all the good things! Switching to these two ANUA cleansers, my pores are clean, the skin does not feel stripped in any way! The toner goes on easy without leaving the skin tacky. It's a perfect base for your morning or night time routines. You won't regret buying anything from this line. I have several of their cleansers, toners, serums, and creams and I have not been disappointed yet!

Absolutely love this toner. It’s lightweight but super hydrating, and my skin just drinks it up. It leaves my face soft, plump, and calm, perfect before moisturizer or retinol/tret nights. It’s tretinoin-safe and makes an amazing first step for skin flooding. No irritation at all, just healthy, dewy skin. I’ll definitely keep this one in my routine 💕
